meta.title: Bioink Composition and Printing Parameters for 3D Modeling Neural Tissue.

extracted_by: Claude (Claude Code session), pending human review
summary: Sodium alginate and gelatin blends were screened as bioinks for printing neural cells. A 6% alginate / 4% gelatin ink printed at 45-70 kPa gave good shape fidelity and supported SH-SY5Y viability.

formulations.review_notes: Print speed converted from 600 mm/min. Viability reported relative to day 0, so no single percentage.
formulations.name: 6% alginate + 4% gelatin
formulations.key_outcome: 6% alginate / 4% gelatin printed at 25 °C and 45-70 kPa was the best balance of printability and viability.

evidence.quote: printed using a temperature of 25 °C and a pressure of 55 kPa for 6%SA–4% GEL bioink and 45 kPa for 4% SA–4% GEL bioink
the print-head speed was set at 600 mm/min and the layer height at 0.4 mm
Cartridge was equipped with a 0.41 mm nozzle.
Our results demonstrated that the optimal conditions were 6% SA and 4% GEL, printed at 25 °C and with a pressure of 45–70 kPa.
